name: govuk-frontend-example-rust
description: Rust + Axum + Askama GOV.UK Frontend example. Server-rendered HTML from Rust; Node only for govuk-frontend pin, Sass, and shared baseline tests.

scripts.verify:docs: npm run format:check && npm run lint:md
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --all
scripts.test: npm run test:baseline && npm run test:styles && npm run build:styles && npm run test:rust
scripts.verify: npm run verify:docs && npm run build:styles && npm test
